+    description: DHCP options to set on the fixed address. Each item requires a value and a name or number.
+    suboptions:
+      name:
+        description: DHCP option name.
+      num:
+        description: DHCP option number.
+        type: int
+      value:
+        description: DHCP option value.
+        required: true
+      use_option:
+        description: Whether to use this option.
+        type: bool

+    options:

+      password: secret

+    name: printer

+    for item in module.params['options'] or []:

+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+from units.compat.mock import patch, MagicMock
+from ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios import api
+from ansible.modules.net_tools.nios import nios_fixed_address
+
+
+class TestNiosFixedAddress(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_main_remaps_address_before_wapi(self):
+        for address, obj_type, key in [('192.0.2.10', api.NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS, 'ipv4addr'),
+                                       ('2001:db8::10', api.NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS, 'ipv6addr')]:
+            module = MagicMock()
+            module.params = dict(provider={}, state='present', name='host', ipaddr=address,
+                                 mac='00:11:22:33:44:55', network='192.0.2.0/24',
+                                 network_view='default', options=None, extattrs=None, comment=None)
+            with patch.object(nios_fixed_address, 'AnsibleModule', return_value=module), \
+                    patch.object(nios_fixed_address, 'WapiModule') as wapi_class:
+                nios_fixed_address.main()
+                self.assertTrue(nios_fixed_address.AnsibleModule.call_args[1]['argument_spec']['provider']['required'])
+                self.assertTrue(nios_fixed_address.AnsibleModule.call_args[1]['supports_check_mode'])
+                self.assertEqual(wapi_class.return_value.run.call_args[0][0], obj_type)
+                self.assertIn(key, wapi_class.return_value.run.call_args[0][1])
+                self.assertEqual(module.params[key], address)
+                self.assertNotIn('ipaddr', module.params)
+                self.assertTrue(module.exit_json.called)
+
+    def test_wapi_idempotence_update_delete_and_check_mode(self):
+        address = '192.0.2.10'
+        params = dict(provider={}, state='present', name='host', ipv4addr=address,
+                      mac='00:11:22:33:44:55', network='192.0.2.0/24',
+                      network_view='default', options=None, extattrs=None, comment=None)
+        spec = dict(name={}, ipv4addr={'ib_req': True}, mac={'ib_req': True},
+                    network={'ib_req': True}, network_view={'ib_req': True},
+                    options={}, extattrs={}, comment={})
+        module = MagicMock()
+        module.params = params
+        module.check_mode = False
+        with patch.object(api, 'get_connector'):
+            wapi = api.WapiModule(module)
+            wapi.get_object = MagicMock(return_value=None)
+            wapi.create_object = MagicMock()
+            wapi.update_object = MagicMock()
+            wapi.delete_object = MagicMock()
+            self.assertTrue(wapi.run(api.NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS, spec)['changed'])
+            expected_filter = dict(ipv4addr=address, mac=params['mac'],
+                                   network=params['network'], network_view='default')
+            self.assertEqual(wapi.get_object.call_args[0],
+                             (api.NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS, expected_filter))
+            wapi.create_object.assert_called_once()
+            existing = dict(params, _ref='fixedaddress/ref')
+            existing.pop('provider')
+            existing.pop('state')
+            existing.pop('options')
+            existing.pop('extattrs')
+            existing.pop('comment')
+            wapi.get_object.return_value = [existing]
+            self.assertFalse(wapi.run(api.NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS, spec)['changed'])
+            params['comment'] = 'updated'
+            wapi.get_object.return_value = [dict(existing, _ref='fixedaddress/ref')]
+            module.check_mode = True
+            self.assertTrue(wapi.run(api.NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS, spec)['changed'])
+            wapi.update_object.assert_not_called()
+            params['state'] = 'absent'
+            wapi.get_object.return_value = [dict(existing, _ref='fixedaddress/ref')]
+            self.assertTrue(wapi.run(api.NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS, spec)['changed'])
+            wapi.delete_object.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_address_types(self):
+        for address, expected, key in [('192.0.2.10', 'fixedaddress', 'ipv4addr'),
+                                       ('2001:db8::10', 'ipv6fixedaddress', 'ipv6addr')]:
+            module = MagicMock()
+            module.params = {'ipaddr': address}
+            spec = {'ipaddr': {'ib_req': True}}
+            obj_type, spec, module = nios_fixed_address.validate_ip_addr_type(address, spec, module)
+            self.assertEqual(obj_type, expected)
+            self.assertIn(key, spec)
+            self.assertEqual(module.params[key], address)
+            self.assertNotIn('ipaddr', spec)
+
+    def test_invalid_address(self):
+        module = MagicMock()
+        nios_fixed_address.validate_ip_addr_type('bad address', {}, module)
+        module.fail_json.assert_called_once()
+
+    def test_options(self):
+        module = MagicMock()
+        module.params = {'options': [dict(name='router', num=None, value='192.0.2.1',
+                                          use_option=True, vendor_class='DHCP')]}
+        self.assertEqual(nios_fixed_address.options(module),
+                         [dict(name='router', value='192.0.2.1',
+                               use_option=True, vendor_class='DHCP')])
+        module.params['options'] = [dict(num=6, value='192.0.2.53', name=None)]
+        self.assertEqual(nios_fixed_address.options(module),
+                         [dict(num=6, value='192.0.2.53', use_option=True,
+                               vendor_class='DHCP')])
+        module.params['options'] = [dict(name=None, num=None, value='bad')]
+        nios_fixed_address.options(module)
+        module.fail_json.assert_called_once()
